name: Notion
summary: Mostly self-serve: create a public connection in Notion's developer portal and users pick which pages to share. Notion's docs say the authorization URL appears after you submit the connection for review, so expect a short review step.
scenario: An agent that reads and updates Notion pages and databases that each user chooses to share.

composio.note: Check the Composio managed OAuth directory for the Notion toolkit.

portal.accountNeeded: A Notion account with a workspace to develop in.

policyAndDomain.detail: The pages checked don't list privacy policy or website requirements for public connections.

adminApproval.detail: Each user authorizes individually and picks pages; no workspace admin step is described.

appReview.detail: The authorization docs say the Authorization URL populates after the public connection is submitted for review, but criteria and timing are not described.

time.note: Notion does not publish a review time for public connections; treat any wait as unknown.

nextStep: In Notion's developer portal go to Build → Public connections → Create new connection, choose 'Any workspace' (this can't be changed later) and add your redirect URI.

prerequisites.text: Decide the installation scope up front: 'Any workspace' is required for Marketplace eligibility and cannot be changed after creation.

steps.title: Create a public connection
steps.detail: Developer portal → Build → Public connections → Create new connection. Set name, development workspace, installation scope and capabilities (read, update, insert content).

steps.title: Add redirect URIs
steps.detail: Add each redirect URI (local, production, Composio's) in the OAuth configuration.

steps.title: Submit and get the authorization URL
steps.detail: Submit the connection; the Authorization URL field is filled in after submission for review.

steps.title: Implement token exchange and refresh
steps.detail: Exchange the code at /v1/oauth/token with HTTP Basic auth, store both tokens, and save the new pair on every refresh.

steps.title: Test page sharing
steps.detail: Authorize with your account and confirm the agent can see only the pages you picked in the page picker.

scopes.name: Capabilities: read / update / insert content
scopes.purpose: Notion uses capabilities on the connection rather than OAuth scope strings; users also pick which pages to share.

review.summary: A submission step exists before you get the authorization URL; Marketplace listing is managed separately.
reviewersCheck: Not documented on the pages checked
review.meanwhile: Build and test against your development workspace.

blockers.issue: Agent can't see a page the user expects.
blockers.fix: Users choose pages in the OAuth page picker; ask them to re-authorize and add the page.

blockers.issue: Connection created with 'Selected workspaces only' can't be listed publicly.
blockers.fix: Create a new connection with 'Any workspace'; scope can't be edited.

nuances.text: Only the authorizing user can use the connection; each teammate authorizes separately.
Refreshing returns a new access token and a new refresh token; store both every time.

uncertainties: Whether Notion's review blocks use by other workspaces, and how long it takes.
Required listing fields (privacy policy, website) for public connections.

corrections: Expected 'no review'. Notion's own auth docs mention submitting the connection for review, so app review is now marked unknown rather than no.
